tasks.label: Streamlit: open Edge (detached)
tasks.detail: Pre-launch of the 'Streamlit + Edge' configuration. Starts .vscode/open-edge.ps1 as a detached background process: no debugger attachment to the browser, and the task returns immediately so that Python debugging starts without delay.

tasks.label: Streamlit: kill port 8501
tasks.detail: Optional. Frees port 8501 if a zombie Streamlit instance is still listening. Not referenced by launch.json.
